Defining the Sovereign Approach

Portfolio Management Services (PMS) represent a tailored investment vehicle where a professional manager handles your investment portfolio of stocks, fixed income, debt, cash, and other individual securities. Unlike mutual funds, where investors own units of a pool, in a PMS, you own the individual securities in your name.

Core Characteristics

  • stars
    Direct Ownership Securities are held in the investor’s own demat account, offering maximum transparency.
  • tune
    Hyper-Customization Portfolios can be tuned to specific tax constraints or sectoral preferences of the investor.
  • shield_person
    Concentrated Focus PMS allows for more concentrated bets compared to the highly diversified nature of retail funds.

The Operational Lifecycle
From Mandate to Maturity

01

Onboarding

Execution of the Discretionary or Non-Discretionary agreement and setup of dedicated demat accounts.

02

Investment Policy

Selection of an investment strategy—Large Cap, Multi-Cap, or Thematic—aligned with your risk profile.

03

Execution

Portfolio Managers execute trades directly into your account, optimizing for market timing and costs.

04

Reporting

Access to live digital dashboards and comprehensive performance reviews on a quarterly basis.

Taxation &
Compliance

receipt_long

Capital Gains

Since individual stocks are held in your name, every transaction attracts STCG (15%) or LTCG (10% over 1 Lakh) based on holding period.

Dividend Income

Dividends received are added to the investor's total income and taxed at the applicable marginal slab rate.

TDS Implications

For Non-Resident Indians (NRIs), Tax Deducted at Source applies on capital gains at the time of trade execution.

Audit Reports

A chartered accountant certified audit report of your PMS account is provided annually for easy tax filing.

Clarifications

Can I withdraw funds mid-term from my PMS? expand_more

Yes, you can withdraw funds at any time. However, many PMS providers have an "Exit Load" ranging from 1% to 3% if funds are withdrawn within the first 1-3 years. Partial withdrawals are also permitted as long as the threshold of INR 50 Lakhs is maintained.

What is the difference between Discretionary and Non-Discretionary PMS? expand_more

In Discretionary PMS, the manager makes all investment decisions. In Non-Discretionary PMS, the manager suggests, but execution only happens after the client's explicit approval for each trade.

Are there any hidden costs in PMS? expand_more

Standard costs include Management Fees, Performance Fees (Profit sharing), Brokerage, Custodian fees, and Audit fees. All these are explicitly mentioned in the Disclosure Document and Agreement.
